title: As the warmth fades into memory.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, no, no, summer's ending, I don't wannaa!
It's way too soon, isn't it! I wanna make way more memories with Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but the meat's so good♡
Let's have Ai-chan grill us way more♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Ai-chan and you guys should eat some meat too, yeah?
Want me to grill it for you? ......Ai-chan? Are you listening?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......Eh? Ah, I'm sorry!
I was thinking about what happened earlier......

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
In the end, no matter how many times I tried, the time didn't change......
It got neither slower nor faster. The same was true for Kiseki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: In other words, what we've been doing——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......Pfft. Fufu. Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh, what!? Ai-chan!? What, what's up!?
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm fine!
Because——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm this satisfied, after all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So——it's all right.
I'm sure it's all right!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The fishing tournament, the walk with everyone, the relaxing in our room too.
It was all fun, and I'm satisfied! So, it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha——right! This summer, we got to have fun together.
Not for the races or anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I love it!
This kind of nothing-happens—— an everyday chapter, too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, these were precious days.
Up until now I've only ever looked forward——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm glad there was a summer like this.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
——Man, walking unknown roads was fun!
We even found an abandoned rail line. Maybe I'll try it on my own next time?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh, when you do, call me! I mean, right?
Doing it again after we get back to the Academy is totally an option too☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahah. What I did with Bright-san seems to have caught on with the underclassmen. Well, it really was fun, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. I'm glad.
But...... being able to take on that kind of thing——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sky-sama. It is all thanks to you.
So, thank you ever so much.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Eh? Is that so? I don't feel like I did anything in particular for you, Bright-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No, that is not true at all.
You are the one who taught me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The importance of stopping your steps "for your own sake."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I have walked for the sake of Mejiro.
Training. Rest too. All of it was time spent to reach a destination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Just for that day. Just for this summer. I was able to devote myself to "pointless things" for no reason other than that I wished to——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
......Fufu. I did not know.
That "doing pointless things"——is a way of filling oneself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
From here on as well, I will devote myself for the sake of Mejiro.
Because that is what I wish to do. But——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I will surely not forget.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This summer—— when I treasured myself, together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Ahah. Yeah, that's it. Right, right, that's exactly it.
That's what Sei-chan wanted to say☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow, to notice the feeling I wanted you to feel——
as expected of Bright-san. What a perceptive person.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
——or so I'd say.
I don't actually think as deeply as you do, Bright-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It's just, well... being with those kids, I got to feeling like, "hmm," you know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because they were making these complicated faces.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
——"At least for summer, isn't it fine to just have fun?"
That's all I wanted to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
......Whoa. I see.
So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ......Ufufu. Sky-sama.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It was sooo much fun! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It was.
